audit.whatIsWrong: The page reads as a favoured lane — diff labelled HARD but diffRating 4/10, a green tone, 'Favoured matchup' in the final rating, Ignite recommended to 'convert the favoured lane' — against a 45.04% win rate. The chart matched that fiction: Level 3, Level 6 and 2+ items all read Renekton at 8/10 while whys[3], whys[4] and whys[6] describe Illaoi dominating those windows.
audit.why: 45.04% over 1845 games; the mirror records the Illaoi side at 58.53%. Packet chart is Renekton, Renekton, Skill, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi and the mirror set its rows 2-6 to Illaoi.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-6 flipped in matched pairs (row 2 to Skill per the packet and this page's own coin-flip why, rows 3-6 to Illaoi), ratings re-spread 5/3/3/3/2, difficulty raised to 7/10 and the final-rating and summoner lines brought in line.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] says 'Dominus gives Illaoi a massive Fury-generation window for back-to-back empowered Ws'. Dominus and Fury are Renekton's; Illaoi has neither. The level-6 spike text credited your own ultimate's effect to the enemy.
audit.why: Renekton R: 'transforms into the Tyrant form ... Renekton gains Fury periodically.' Illaoi R spawns a tentacle per champion hit.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text rewritten so Dominus is yours and Leap of Faith's tentacle spawn is hers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Test of Spirit's numbers were never given ('dodging this is the whole matchup'), and Harsh Lesson — the leap that resets her auto and makes every nearby tentacle swing at you — never appeared on the full layer at all, even though it is the actual burst tell. wants.you[1] also names her E as 'Tentacle Smash spirit rip'; Tentacle Smash is her Q, the rip is Test of Spirit.
audit.why: Illaoi E: 900 range, 16/15/14/13/12, 'Spirits echo a percentage of the damage they take to the original target'. W: 400 range, 4s, leap that makes nearby tentacles swing at the target and resets her attack. P heals her when tentacles damage a champion.
audit.corrected: Range and 16s cooldown in dosFull[0].d and report[5].t; the 4s Harsh Lesson auto-reset named as the tell; the spirit's damage echo in dontsFull[1].d; the ability name fixed in wants.you[1].
